summary: SRV Yhtiöt Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a project management contractor company in Finland. The company builds and develops commercial and business premises, such as offices, hotels, retail premises, and industrial and logistics centers; and housing. It also provides building maintenance, renovation, and technology services; technical units and procurement; internal services; building services engineering; and energy and lifecycle services. SRV Yhtiöt Oyj was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
